payload.description_html:
Fig 24. Thyrsitoides cangrandei n. sp.
Lateral view in natural light and coated in alcohol of the holotype, IGVR 82445 (A). Lateral view of the paratype IGVR 67880, coated in alcohol and detail of the cranium (B-C). Interpretive reconstruction of the skeleton (infraorbital series is omitted; D). Scale bars 10 mm.
